# Doctor Uncle Family Clinic

> Family clinic with two branches near Tirur, Malappuram district, Kerala, India. The Vakkad branch (near Malayalam University) is open 24 hours with a casualty department; the Unniyal branch (Unniyal Junction, Tanur Road) is open 7 AM to 10 PM. Primary care, diabetes care, minor surgery, home care, laboratory and ECG, pharmacy and telemedicine.

## Branches
- Vakkad branch: Near Malayalam University, Vakkad, Tirur, Kerala 676502. Open 24 hours, every day, including casualty (emergency) care. Phone: +91 99615 88880
- Unniyal branch: Unniyal Junction, Tanur Road, Unniyal, Kerala. Open 7 AM to 10 PM, every day. Phone: +91 80897 71640, +91 80897 71641
- Email: contact@doctoruncle.in

## Services
- General medicine and primary care for all ages: fever, infections, chronic conditions, check-ups
- Diabetes care: personalised treatment plans, continuous glucose monitoring, diet counselling
- Minor surgical procedures
- Women's health, including prenatal care
- Home care in Vakkad, Unniyal, Tanur and nearby areas: doctor home visits, nursing care, injections and IV infusions, physiotherapy, ECG, home sample collection for lab tests. Home care bookings: +91 99615 88880
- Laboratory tests and ECG
- On-site pharmacy
- Telemedicine consultations
